card.title: Vice President of Operations, Piston Interiors
card.description:
Overview:

The Vice President of Operations at Piston Interiors is a key member of the executive leadership team, reporting directly to the President. This role provides enterprise-level leadership for Piston Interiors operations across the United States and Mexico and has direct responsibility for multi-plant manufacturing execution across five manufacturing facilities in northern Mexico and two distribution centers along the Texas border, supporting a workforce of more than 7,000 employees. The VP of Operations leads Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and launch execution; drives Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Productivity, Profitability, and Customer Performance; and builds a culture of disciplined continuous improvement, leadership accountability, and reliable execution. Candidate must be located in Acuna, Mexico or Metro-Detroit, United States to be considered for this position. Relocation will be considered.

Responsibilities:

**Strategic Operations Leadership**
 

* Serve as the senior-most Operations executive for Piston Int eriors, setting enterprise direction across U.S. and Mexico

operations and maintaining direct accountability for manufacturing and distribution performance across all locations.
 

* Establish a clear manufacturing approach and translate business strategy into annual operating plans, budgets, capital

priorities, capacity decisions, and measurable operating objectives.
 

* Advise the President and executive leadership team on operating performance, customer commitments, risk, growth

readiness, resource requirements, and strategic opportunities.

**Multi-Site Operations & Performance Accountability**
 

* Lead plant and distribution-center execution across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, labor efficiency, schedule

attainment, scrap, premium freight, inventory, throughput, and profitability.
 

* Establish consistent daily, weekly, and monthly management cadence, visual controls, performance measures,

escalation routines, and corrective-action discipline across the operating network.
 

* Ensure safe working conditions, regulatory and legal compliance, ethical conduct, operational continuity, and reliable

delivery of customer commitments.
 
 
**Piston Production System (PPS), Lean & Continuous Improvement**
 

* Lead the cultural and process transformation from maximizing production-minute utilization to a disciplined focus on

productivity, efficiency, quality, flow, profitability, and sustainable performance.
 

* Deploy and sustain the Piston Production System, including standard work, visual management, tiered accountability,

structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, and continuous improvement.
 

* Use operational data and technology to improve labor utilization, first-pass yield, scrap, downtime, throughput,

process capability, and decision quality.

**Financial Performance & Resource Optimization**
 

* Own operating performance against profit-and-loss, cash, working-capital, productivity, cost-reduction, and annual

operating-plan commitments.
 

* Plan and manage direct and indirect labor, operating budgets, capital, equipment, facilities, inventory, logistics, and

other resources in alignment with financial objectives.
 

* Partner with Finance to understand cost drivers, program and customer profitability, forecast accuracy, capital returns,

and the financial impact of operating decisions.

**Supply Chain, Capacity & Cross-Border Operations**
 

* Provide executive oversight for production planning, materials, purchasing, logistics, distribution, supplier

performance, capacity, inventory, and business continuity.
 

* Optimize manufacturing and distribution capacity across the United States and Mexico while ensuring compliance with

applicable IMMEX, customs, import/export, USMCA, labor, and regulatory requirements.

**Growth, Engineering & Launch Excellence**
 

* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Finance, and Supply Chain to secure and launch new

business with disciplined manufacturability, capacity, cost, capital, quality, and resource assumptions.
 

* Lead integrated launch readiness and execution, protecting existing operations while meeting customer timing,

delivery, quality, and profitability expectations.

**Organization & Talent Leadership**
 

* Review and optimize the operations organization structure, leadership capability, spans of control, role clarity, and

succession depth required to support current performance and future growth.
 

* Build, coach, and hold accountable a cohesive, high-performing multi-plant leadership team; align goal setting,

performance, development, and succession practices with the ONE PISTON Talent Cycle.

**Culture, Customer & Stakeholder Leadership**
 

* Inspire a culture of winning, disciplined execution, continuous improvement, trust, and collaboration while maintaining

an organizational climate that prioritizes safety, dignity, pride, satisfaction, and well-being at work.
 

* Build credibility with customers, employees, executive leaders, suppliers, and community stakeholders through

transparent communication, predictable results, ethical leadership, and decisive action.

Qualifications:

**Education / Experience / Skills & Abilities**
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field;

Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
 

* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience within automotive manufacturing,

including significant multi-site responsibility and leadership through other leaders.
 

* Automotive Tier 1 supplier experience required, with direct accountability for manufacturing, quality, industrial

engineering, supply chain, program/launch execution, customer delivery, and plant financial performance.
 

* Demonstrated profit-and-loss leadership, including budgeting, forecasting, labor management, working capital, capital

planning, cost reduction, and profitability improvement.
 

* Proven success implementing lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, daily management systems, and plant or

network turnaround initiatives.
 

* Significant experience leading U.S.-Mexico cross-border manufacturing operations; experience within an IMMEX

maquiladora environment strongly preferred.
 

* Experience in automotive interiors, cut-and-sew, seat trim, visors, leather/vinyl processing, or other labor-intensive

manufacturing strongly preferred.
 

* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish required.
* Strong business acumen, analytical capability, technical manufacturing knowledge, and the ability to communicate,

influence, negotiate, and build trust across all organizational levels and stakeholders.

card.title: Director of Medical Group Operations
card.description:
Overview:

Director of Medical Group Operations| Medical Practice Leadership

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group| Aurora, Illinois

Full-Time | Exempt | Days 
Starting Annual Salary: $101,212.80 – $146,619.20

Lead Practice Excellence. Empower Providers. Advance Patient Access.

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group, a member of Prime Healthcare, is seeking an experienced and collaborative Director of Medical Group Operations to lead the operational performance, growth, and success of physician practices and ambulatory clinics throughout the Aurora market.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a healthcare operations leader who enjoys partnering with physicians, practice leaders, and executive leadership to strengthen practice performance, improve patient access, optimize workflows, and advance strategic growth across a multi-specialty medical group.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically, lead confidently, and drive operational excellence while supporting providers in delivering exceptional, patient-centered care throughout the community.

About Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group brings together primary care and specialty providers across Illinois, with medical group locations affiliated with Prime Healthcare's Illinois hospitals, including Mercy Medical Center in Aurora.

Our physicians, advanced practice providers, practice leaders, and support teams work collaboratively to provide accessible, coordinated, high-quality care while creating an exceptional patient experience.

As part of Prime Healthcare, Illinois Medical Group benefits from the resources, support, and stability of a nationally recognized health system while maintaining a strong commitment to the healthcare needs of the communities it serves.

Responsibilities:

As Director of Medical Group Operations, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for physician practices and ambulatory services while supporting growth, operational efficiency, provider engagement, and exceptional patient experiences.

* Lead day-to-day operations of physician practices and medical group clinics to ensure high-quality patient care and operational excellence.
* Partner with physicians, practice managers, and executive leadership to develop strategies that support growth, patient access, and performance improvement.
* Oversee staffing, budgeting, productivity, scheduling, and resource allocation across multiple practice locations.
* Monitor operational, financial, quality, and patient experience metrics while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, and professional practice guidelines.
* Drive initiatives focused on patient access, provider satisfaction, workflow optimization, revenue enhancement, and service-line development.
* Develop, mentor, and support practice leaders and staff while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and exceptional service.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in business or healthcare management is preferred.
* Master’s degree in business or healthcare management preferred.
* Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in medical practice management required (with direct experience managing the revenue cycle).
* Knowledge of Accounts Receivable management, coding, Medicare & Medicaid regulations, payor contracting, and Billing & Collections.
* Knowledge of credentialing, regulatory compliance, etc.
* Frequent local travel time required.

The Leader Who Will Thrive Here

You are a collaborative, results-driven healthcare leader who is passionate about medical practice operations, provider engagement, and patient access. You thrive in a fast-paced, multi-site environment where relationship-building, operational excellence, and strategic leadership are essential.

You understand that successful medical group leadership goes beyond managing day-to-day operations. It requires vision, accountability, and the ability to bring physicians, practice leaders, and staff together around shared goals that improve access, efficiency, patient satisfaction, and overall performance.

You are a self-starter and hands-on leader who communicates openly, follows through, takes accountability, and is comfortable stepping in to solve operational challenges. You enjoy developing teams, improving workflows, and partnering closely with providers and executive leadership to strengthen medical group performance. These qualities align with the leadership profile established for the Aurora opening.

Why Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group?

At Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group, you'll have the opportunity to lead and develop a network of physician practices while partnering closely with providers, practice leaders, and healthcare executives to strengthen outpatient operations and improve the patient experience.

You'll have the opportunity to improve patient access, strengthen revenue cycle and operational performance, support provider success, develop practice leaders, and help drive the continued growth of a multi-specialty medical group.

Prime Healthcare's Illinois Medical Group network serves communities through medical groups affiliated with hospitals across the state, including Mercy Medical Center, Resurrection Medical Center, Saint Francis Hospital, Saint Joseph Hospital, Saint Joseph Medical Center, Saint Mary of Nazareth Hospital, St. Mary’s Hospital, and Olympia Fields Hospital. As part of Prime Healthcare, the Medical Group benefits from the resources of Prime Healthcare, stability, and opportunities of a nationally recognized, award-winning health system.

If you're ready to bring your medical group leadership experience to an organization where you can make a measurable impact on practice performance, provider engagement, patient access, and patient care, we encourage you to apply.

#LI-JJ3

#LI-TA1

Pay Transparency:

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. A reasonable compensation estimate for this role, which includes estimated wages, benefits, and other forms of compensation, is $101,212.80 to $146,619.20 on an annualized basis. The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire, in which a wide range of factors will be considered, including but not limited to, skillset, years of applicable experience, education, credentials and licensure.

The company is dedicated to empowering its staff with a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, allowing them the freedom to customize their benefits to fit their unique needs. Our abundant resources, programs, and voluntary options serve as a foundation for individual growth and well-being. Learn more here: https://www.primehealthcare.com/benefitsthatmattermost/

Employment Status: Full Time Shift: Days Equal Employment Opportunity:

Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. Company prohibits discrimination against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (subject to applicable law), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. The District Director of (Hospital) Operations is responsible for driving operational precision and efficiency across a defined geographic district of hospitals. This role focuses on optimizing patient flow, reducing length of stay (LOS), and improving care transitions to enhance both patient outcomes and financial sustainability. The district director will implement standardized best practices, leverage data-driven insights, and collaborate with site leaders and key hospital partners to ensure seamless, high-quality, and cost-effective hospital operations.

**Essential Functions**

**Operational Precision and Standardization**

* Implement practice-wide operational strategies to enhance patient throughput, capacity management, and resource utilization
* Responsible to execute the standardized operational workflows across all hospitals to drive efficiency, reduce variability, and improve care coordination
* Establish and review real-time monitoring and predictive analytics to optimize patient flow and discharge planning

**Patient Flow Optimization & Length of Stay Reduction**

* Ensure accountability among site leaders for optimizing hospital throughput, reducing emergency department (ED) boarding, and expediting inpatient admissions.
* Drive accountability for the implementation of Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) methodologies by site leaders to effectively reduce length of stay (LOS) while maintaining the highest standards of care.
* Hold site leaders accountable for enhancing discharge planning processes to facilitate timely transitions and minimize avoidable delays.
* Ensure and round on IP team participation in hospital-wide interdisciplinary rounds and escalation protocols to support efficient, data-driven decision-making.

**Transitions of Care & Post-Acute Coordination**

* Hold site leaders accountable for driving collaboration between hospital teams and post-acute care providers to ensure seamless patient transitions and continuity of care.
* Ensure site leaders implement hospital-wide strategies to reduce readmissions and enhance care coordination across inpatient, outpatient, and home settings.
* Hold site leaders responsible for leveraging predictive analytics to identify high-risk patients and proactively manage discharge planning to prevent avoidable delays and readmissions.
* Ensure site leaders actively partner with case management, nursing, and providers to strengthen care transitions

**Financial & Resource Optimization**

* Hold site leaders accountable for driving operational efficiencies that align with financial goals, ensuring optimal resource allocation and cost control.
* Ensure site leaders implement workforce optimization strategies that balance staffing efficiency with high-quality patient care.

**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Standards**

* Ensure site leaders and teams uphold compliance with federal, state, and local healthcare regulations, including but not limited to CMS and Joint Commission standards.
* Hold site leaders accountable for meeting patient flow and discharge-related quality measures, including readmission reduction initiatives.
* Ensure site leaders champion a culture of continuous quality improvement, focusing on both operational performance and patient experience.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Drive lasting relationships with hospital partners
* Hold site leaders accountable for providing strong leadership to hospital clinical teams, and operational managers.
* Ensure site leaders’ mentor and develop teams to foster a culture of accountability, efficiency, and patient-centered care.

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* Ability to lead with empathy and inspire a team
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Window-based applications.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrate expertise in leading large teams in a complex matrixed environment
* Demonstrate expertise in patient flow management, LOS reduction, discharge planning, and transitions of care
* Proven track record of successfully implementing operational best practices across multiple hospital locations
* Excellent coaching skills to leverage operational success from leaders
* Other duties and special projects as assigned

**Required Credentials**

* Graduate of approved Program of Physical Therapy by APTA and CAPTE or related field of study
* 5+ years of progressive therapy practice experience, with at least 5 years in a management role.
* Previous experience in facility or health care management or business school related training.
* Licensure appropriate to governing body of state licensing board.
* Current American Heart Association BLS certification required.

card.description:
Location: Boston, United States Job reference: R-264982 Date posted: 11/24/2026

**Position Summary**

The Senior Manager Country Operations Management (SM COM) reports to the Head of Country Operations and/or Director Study Start up and Site Partnership. SMCOM has the accountability to support the Country strategy implementation, to act as company culture and value ambassador and to act as line manager of local functions as agreed.

The Senior Manager Country Operations Management is accountable for all assigned operational trial deliverables across programs are completed according to timelines, operational procedures, quality standards, SOPs and guidelines, independently if the trial is directly manage by the SMCOM or by his/her direct reports.

The Senior Manager Country Operations Management is responsible for day-to-day management of a dedicated functional group(s) within Country Operations Management local team, and is responsible for planning and utilization of staff resources, objective setting and performance development. The SM COM is responsible for their direct reports delivery to study expectations.

It is also expected that the SM COM may contribute to regional/global initiatives as delegated.

In some countries SM COM may also take other responsibilities such as Clinical Study Administrator, Clinical Reasearch Associate and.or Project Manager Country Operations if required, as agreed with the Head of Country Operations (HCO).

**Accountabilities:**

* Leading and developing of the dedicated functional group within Country Operations Management at local level.
* Ensures adequate resources for the studies assigned, ensure that workload of direct reports is optimized, and ensures appropriate and timely assignment to projects by liaising with relevant stakeholders (CSA, CRA, PMCO, global study team, etc).
* Development and performance management of direct reports, including implementation of development and training plan and regular coaching of the direct reports.
* Prepares salary and bonus proposals for direct reports based on their performance in close collaboration with responsible HCO
* Manages new staff interviews, hiring, onboarding process, for full-time and and in-sourced staff
* Ensures that study activities at country level comply with local policies and code of ethics, and ensures team delivery to committed activation and recruitment targets
* Contribute to Country data analysis for new or ongoing clinical trials (as applicable, depending on the direct reports the LM will be managing).
* Support the Country external scientific engagement strategy and action plan.
* Contribute to efficient COM organization and its functioning at country level by working closely with responsible HCO.
* Support DCOM, DSSU/SP and HCO and in-Country COM activities , such as Site Oversight Visit reports review (as applicable, depending on the direct reports the LM will be managing) and onboarding and training of new in-Country COM functions and team members
* Act as extended local leadership team member with accountability to support the Country strategy implementation, champion the company values and support HCO with the local affiliate and global DRS team cross-functional interactions required to support local COM goals.
* Contribute to the quality improvement of the study processes and other procedures through close partnership with DCQ at Country level
* Support inspection readiness activities at site and country level.
* Collaborates in identifying patient, site or country level quality deficiencies which may lead to the creation quality events/issues, and support in discussions around those as required (i.e: CAPAs). This may include to conduct Site Oversight Visits triggered by observed quality signals

**Essential Skills & Experience:**

* Bachelors degree in related discipline, preferably in life science, or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Development Operations (CRA / Sr. CRA / Project management) or other related fields.
* Strong leadership to drive team growth, development and support the local COM strategy implementation
* Pro-active identification of requirements to support future needs
* Business acumen to understand company direction and drive the understanding at team level
* Solution oriented attitude and ability to lead through ambiguity
* Excellent interpersonal skills, proactivity and assertiveness.
* Manage change with a positive approach for self, team and business. Sees change as an opportunity to improve performance and add value to business.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, influencing and negotiation skills.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, verbal and written.
* Excellent knowledge of spoken and written English.
* Ability for national and international travel.
* Integrity and high ethical standards.

**Desirable Skills & Experience:**

* Line management experience and good resource management skills
* Prior CRA experience
* Excellent knowledge of the Monitoring Process.
* Good understanding of the Study Drug Handling Process and the Data Management Process.

card.title: Director, Warehouse Operations
card.description:
Role Overview:

The Director, Warehouse Operations is accountable for effectively managing US warehousing operations to include receiving, shipping, transfers, inventory control, labor management, and safeguarding Brother assets. The position is accountable for the Warehouse Operations budget to control costs and to reduce expenditures without compromising the operation’s capabilities to service customers. The Director, Warehouse Operations is accountable for the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives that will enable operational efficiencies across all warehouses to improve customer satisfaction and savings. This position creates an environment of collaboration and respect among the various departments such as Finance, Information Technology (IT) and Transportation to drive overall supply chain excellence throughout the delivery process.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Operations Management

* + Oversee daily warehouse operations within the Brother distribution network (East Coast, West Coast, Tennessee, etc.)
 + Drive improvement through collaboration and analysis; support manufacturing, channel partners, and end-users
 + Monitor all warehousing operations in designated external warehouses while utilizing best practices
 + Ensure shipment compliance including the quality, timing and accurate delivery of products
 + Drive performance results through the management of the third partly logistics provider
 + Provide direction, leadership and guidance to leadership staff and monitor the efficiency, knowledge and skill sets of the staff and provide the necessary guidance, training, coaching, feedback and appraisal as necessary
 + Create an environment of collaboration, innovation, problem-solving and continuous improvement
 + Foster inventory strategies that deliver improvements in productivity, quality, and cost
 + Identify the best way to ensure correct inventory management by creating a robust repeatable process including the latest technology
 + Develop, direct, and manage overall improvement targets and oversee execution of initiatives
 + Work closely with the Supply Chain Planning team to guarantee “hot items” are available at the Warehouse to satisfy customer demand
 + Work closely with the Inbound / Outbound Transportation teams to guarantee “hot containers” and/or “hot orders” are managed by aligned Customer Service Levels Agreements

Strategic Direction

* + Develop an overall plan from the current state to the future state that meets business and customer requirements for best-in-class service for inventory, warehousing operations and delivery
 + Assess current and future operational risks locally, and translate those into strategies, capabilities, best practices, and key performance indicators (KPIs)
 + Develop and deploy inventory and operations performance standards that support and align with company strategy and customer expectations across the distribution network
 + Develop a continuous improvement approach across the warehouse operations organization to challenge the operational “status quo” and optimize operational cost and service
 + Partner with the HR, IT, Procurement and Financial teams to address open issues and develop best-in-class cross functional practices, processes, metrics, and reports for the warehouse operations area
 + Work closely with the Supply Chain Planning team to plan for future warehouse space for efficient utilization to minimize expenses
 + Work closely with the Inbound / Outbound Transportation teams to develop joint plans to improve customer service levels and operational costs
 + Work closely with the order management team to define “Total Order Cycle” optimization initiatives to improve customer satisfaction and operational costs

Provider and Vendor Management

* + Conduct monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBR & QBR) with all 3rd party providers to ensure consistent Service Levels are met and business and customer needs are addressed
 + Partner with the procurement organization to manage vendor relationships and pricing agreements for warehousing services
 + Ensure business and customer service commitments are being upheld and address deficiencies accordingly
 + Develop a continuous improvement approach with all 3rd party providers to maximize customer service levels and optimize operational costs
 + Manage leasing of available space and ensure warehouse facilities are maintained to support shipping and Customer Service

Management of Departmental Financial Responsibilities

* + Create the annual divisional budget
 + Partner with Finance to perform Monthly budget analysis for all Warehouse Operational costs and develop bridge plans to stay within the budget requirements while still maintaining the required Business and Customer service levels
 + Continually identify opportunities for improvement, quality, cost and service
 + Develop Monthly Warehouse Operations Risk & Opportunities based on operational efficiencies/inefficiencies
 + Partner with the Finance team to identify and track the financial impacts of continuous improvement initiatives
 + Ensure that all warehouse operations financial functions are accurate, and timely and meet all established JSOX and financial policies
 + Track, analyze, and report warehouse and 3PL labor costs and develop corrective actions if not achieving targets

Experience & Qualifications:

Education Level

* + Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics or related field- Required
 + Master's Degree (or equivalent experience) Business, Supply Chain, Logistics or related field- preferred

Experience Level

* + Minimum 12 years 
 - Managing a high-volume distribution center including extensive inventory control experience.Managing onsite 3PL vendor relationships and performance metrics.
 + Minimum 10 years 
 - Leading national warehouse operations
 + Minimum 7 years 
 - Continuous Improvement and operational transformation achievements

Software/Technical Skills

* + Warehouse Management System (WMS)
 + Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
 + SAP Order Management

Other Skills/Knowledge/Abilities

* + Strong attention to quality and detail
 + Ability to impact change through influence and collaboration across multiple levels of the organization
 + Ability to successfully manage through complexity
 + Demonstrated leadership and management skills; the ability to motivate positive and cooperative working relationships
 + Knowledge of accounting principles and practices
 + Demonstrated ability to articulate a vision, translating it into executable strategy and driving cross-functional teams to deliver against a plan
 + Advanced continuous improvement skills and operational application
 + Project management and large project oversight experience

 
Additional Details for This Role:

This role will be an onsite role. You are expected to work from the stated job location 5 days a week. #LI-Onsite

Base Salary

* + The targeted base salary range for this position is **$ 165,000.00- $ 185,000.00** per year.
 + Base salary is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the successful candidate, as well as factors such as internal equity, cost of labor in the hiring location, and alignment with market data.

Additional Compensation

* + This position is eligible for a **30%** bonus at 100% of target, with the opportunity to achieve above 100% dependent on company performance and in alignment with company bonus plans.
 + Bonus awards are discretionary and contingent upon individual performance as well as Brother achieving its corporate objectives, in accordance with the applicable bonus plan in effect.

**Work type:** Management (MPP)
 
**Location:** Pomona
 
**Categories:** MPP, Administrative, At-Will, Full Time, On-site (work in-person at business location)

**Type of Appointment:** Full-Time, At-Will
 
 
**Job Classification:** Administrator II
 
 
**Anticipated Hiring Range:** Up to $10,833 per month (Commensurate with skills and qualifications)
 
 
**Work Schedule:** 8:00am-5:00pm Mon - Fri, possible weekend 
 
 
 
**THE DEPARTMENT:**
 
 
The College of Agriculture is one of five agricultural colleges in California. It is the sole provider of comprehensive agricultural programs focusing on the needs of the $1 trillion Southern California economy and its 22 million people. The College provides a unique integrative approach to agricultural education that recognizes the strong disciplinary interdependencies related to professional orientation and culture, basic societal needs, lifestyles, and social and environmental responsibility. It is well positioned to meet the expanding demand for qualified graduates in highly specialized fields within the agricultural, food, fiber, and animal industries. The farming facilities, Farm Store and AGRlscapes support the educational mission of the College of Agriculture and are vital to the College's legacy and excellent reputation.
 
 
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Operational Leadership and Strategic Direction

* In coordination with the Dean, Associate Dean, and appropriate college faculty, provide operational leadership and strategic direction for the Huntley College’s agricultural and animal operations in support of the college and university missions.
* Responsible for operational and financial planning, implementation and control in a fiscally viable, legally compliant and environmentally responsible manner.
* Function as the HEERA manager and provide overall supervision of state and foundation members of staff plus part-time student employees.

Fiscal Responsibilities:

* Develop, plan, manage, and monitor an $8 million operations budget.
* Align resource allocation with College of Ag goals and objectives and provision of services necessary to provide high-quality Ag products in a safe, effective learning environment.
* Oversee the effective and sustainable use of over 600 acres of field crops, tree and vine, horticulture, and pasture lands located on main CPP campus, Spadra Ranch, Pine Tree Ranch (Santa Paula), and AGRlscapes.
* Plan, coordinate, and manage production of over 60 different agricultural commodities to include greenhouse hydroponic fruit, vegetables and ornamental plants. Responsible for the safety training and documentation for all faculty, staff, and students involved in operating equipment, vehicles, and any related farm tools and machinery or pesticides.
* Creates and maintains partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Educates campus and community constituents regarding agriculture and functions in a way as to foster Development and Alumni relations regarding Agriculture at Cal Poly Pomona.
* Manages a farm crew of approximately 10 State and Foundation employees and an additional 50 student workers.
* Responsible for the safety training and documentation for all faculty, staff and students involved in operating equipment, vehicles and any related farm tools and machinery or pesticides.
* Prepares performance reviews for assigned staff.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's Degree - Required fields include: agricultural science, agricultural management, agribusiness, agricultural business, agricultural economics, business administration, finance, or a closely related field is required. Candidates with degrees in business administration or finance must also demonstrate substantial experience managing agricultural or livestock operations.
* A Pest Control Advisor (PCA) license or the ability to obtain a PCA license within 6 months
* Driver's license, valid and in-state
* A minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience managing agricultural, farming, or livestock operations, including experience with modern agricultural practices, personnel supervision, budgeting, equipment, and safety.
* Candidates selected for this position will be required to complete a credit check before appointment.
* Demonstrated accomplishments in agricultural production, farm management, or related operations are required.
* A thorough knowledge of the planning, implementation, and control of sustainable agriculture/ animal husbandry operations.
* Knowledge of all laws and regulations related to safe and environmentally responsible agriculture.
* Familiarity with requirements to maintain organic certification.
* Knowledge of technologies, methods, practices, and procedures used in modern agriculture, personnel and financial management.
* A thorough knowledge of efficient production of field crops, tree and vine, horticulture and pasture lands to include all equipment involved;
* Knowledge of safety and regulations related to safe and environmentally responsible agriculture.
 

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* An earned master’s degree in agriculture, agricultural business, agricultural management, business administration, or a science-related field.
* A Certified Crop Adviser (CCA) credential, or the ability and appropriate coursework to obtain the credential.
* Conversational or professional proficiency in Spanish.
* Experience managing diverse agricultural operations, including field crops, orchards or vineyards, horticulture, pasture, and livestock.
* Experience with farm equipment, irrigation systems, agricultural facilities, and capital improvement planning.
* Experience establishing and maintaining field research trials.
* Experience working in a higher education or academic agricultural environment, including coordinating with faculty and campus partners to support teaching, research, and student learning.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, communicate, and work collaboratively with employees, students, faculty, campus partners, and individuals from diverse backgrounds.
* Demonstrated success supervising employees and students.
* A record of accomplishment in fiscal responsibility and budget management
 

**Benefits**
 
 
At California State University (CSU), we prioritize the health, growth, and success of our employees. Our benefits program reflects our commitment to your overall well-being.

To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. card.description:
Overview:

**Who We Are:**

Crowley is a privately held, U.S.-owned and operated company serving the maritime, logistics and energy industries with scale in 36 nations and island territories. Our Purpose is to bravely advance what’s possible to elevate people and planet, guided by our values of Integrity, Sustainability and Drive.

With more than $3 billion in annual revenue, our solutions provide integrated supply chains with a commitment to safety and reliability in our ocean and land transportation services and facilities.

We set high standards, operate with discipline, and continuously improve how we work. Performance, operational excellence and innovation drive how we compete, grow and deliver to our customers and partners.

**Work Arrangement:**

Onsite

**What You'll Do:**

Responsible for directing the port and/or terminal operations by ensuring the company is compliant with all regulatory regulations; in addition to the safe discharge, organization, storage and movement of cargo throughout the terminal.

Responsibilities:

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Ensure all operations are in compliance with all local and federal entities and environmentally sound practices are communicated and followed.
* Responsible for interaction with vessel operations, other terminals, scheduling, damage prevention, quality, and safety initiatives.
* Establishes operating budget and reviews operating results to ensure budgeted goals are achieved.
* Ensures all accounting issues, contracting agreements and financial reporting is timely completed, managed, and administered.
* Develop mentor and manage cross functional teams and work with strategic leaders.
* Ensure all operations are in compliance with all Local and Federal Entities (OSHA, PROSHA, EPA, EQB, USCG, DOT, etc.) and all Crowley policies and procedures including ISO.
* Coordinate and negotiate outside contractor and service provider alliances/ agreements, operate in various locations, and interface/coordinate with various internal departments and external organizations.
* Responsible to oversee and participate in hiring, training, evaluation, and discipline of personnel.
* Responsible for an annual budget in excess of 30M, including investigations, and details of variances.
* Responsible for the review, verification, and approval of all major expenses related to Terminal and Port Operations in accordance to company guidelines.

Qualifications:

**Experience:**

* 8+ years prior experience preferably working in the terminal and/or stevedoring operations.
* In addition to 3 – 5 years’ experience in a supervisory experience managing cross function teams.

**Education and Credentials:**

* Bachelor's degree in logistics, business administration, transportation or related field; or a combination of post-high school and equal experience may be substituted for education.

**Technical Skills:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office products, including Excel, Outlook and Word.
* Proficient in various terminal systems, i.e. TOS, CICS, etc.

**Other:**

* Subject to a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check to obtain your driving history.

**Competencies:**

Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing, including conveying technical information to technical and non-technical users. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal/external business partners. Ability to evaluate process effectiveness and develop change or alternatives. Ability to function effectively with, or as part of a team. Ability to indirectly mentor, coach, train and/or supervise employees. Ability effectively manage projects that may vary in nature and scope. Ability to utilize problem solving skills. Ability to identify complex problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions. Ability to prioritize, organize and perform multiple work assignments simultaneously. Ability to apply skill sets and demonstrate proven experience developing, improving and streamlining processes to meet established goals and objectives. Ability to manage employee and client relationships to achieve specific goals for generating and maintaining sales of products and services.

**Working Conditions:**

Works both inside an office environment and also outside in conditions of both high and low temperatures. May be exposed to odors, dust, dirt, mechanical hazards, high noise levels and potentially dangerous equipment. Must be able to crouch and stoop to get into areas with restricted headroom and be able to climb ladders. May require extended use of computer keyboard and viewing of computer monitor and ability to sit for long periods of time.

**What We Offer?**

**We inspire top talent by offering a comprehensive and competitive package that supports the diverse needs of our people—on land, at sea, in offices, and remotely.**

**Our Total Rewards include:**

 

* Competitive pay with recognition programs
* Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, and paid vacation and holidays
* Leave and family support: parental leave and sick leave
* Learning and growth: access to training and development for continuous skill development
* Well-being resources: Employee Assistance Program, wellness program, and gym membership discounts

**At Crowley, we invest in you—your success, your health, and your future.**

Industry

Transportation

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

**We are seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking leader to help shape the next chapter of our Infrastructure business across California.** This highly visible leadership role will bring together our consolidated Infrastructure operations across the region, with responsibility for driving profitable growth, operational and project delivery excellence, client relationships, and talent strategy. The successful candidate will combine strong commercial and market acumen with inspirational leadership, positioning the business for sustained growth while strengthening how we serve our clients, develop our people, and deliver complex infrastructure solutions across California.

 

This role will be based within one of our offices within the California region and will serve as a key strategic leader for the business, overseeing all aspects of the consolidated Infrastructure operations. This includes a strong understanding of market drivers, project opportunities, project finances, delivery, and execution, as well as talent management.

**Vision for the Role**:

* Drive strategic, profitable growth and operational excellence across the portfolio
* Diversify offerings and client base to build resilience into the portfolio
* Build and maintain executive-level client relationships
 

**Performance Expectations and Leadership Accountabilities:**

* The role will report to the West Region Executive Vice President and General Manager, Eva Wood.
* Promote our BeyondZero Health & Safety, Inclusion, and business ethics culture. Foster inclusive behaviors to achieve market-leading and innovative business outcomes across markets, while creating an environment that enables our people to thrive.
* In collaboration with the respective Executive Director of Sales (EDS), develop a comprehensive growth strategy and establish strong C-suite relationships with key clients to create mutually beneficial partnerships that will grow the business.
* Effective responsibility of commercial aspects of the business (project performance, management of P&L, including G&A management, net revenue, gross profit, and operating profit). Provide oversight of operational governance and ensure adherence to processes. Drive achievement of Global Integrated Delivery (GID) targets.
* Provide effective, visible, and inspirational leadership and demonstrate strong business acumen and commercial savviness while closely working with the EDSs, Geographic Director of Projects, Financial Manager, as well as with other team members from various support functions.
* Drive delivery and operational excellence through discipline around change management, risk management, and quality management.
* Attract, retain, and develop key talent to position Jacobs for sustained growth. Drive key people-related actions, including advocating for, developing, and sponsoring key talent and career development.
* Identify potential acquisitions and partnerships to grow the business in the geography.
* Provide important leadership contributions to Americas West, Americas and Jacobs Senior Leadership Teams.
* Provide strategic leadership and collaboration for our West operations across all business units. This role will serve as an important ambassador to continue to enhance our profile with clients, multiple levels of government, potential recruits and the community.
* Success will be measured using clear, quantifiable performance metrics showing how well the geography delivered the organization’s strategic goals and outcomes.

 

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs' offices/projects and remote locations, enabling them to deliver their best work.

Here's what you'll need

* Progressive experience in the consulting and engineering industry or other related fields

* Demonstrated passion for leadership along with proven leadership capability and skills
* P&L experience required with demonstrated commercial and business acumen
* Strong endorsement of innovative solutions, and technology
* Demonstrated inspirational and inclusive leadership skills and capability
* In-depth experience with project management, construction management and client management
* Outstanding organizational and verbal/written communication skills
* A strong client relationship network in the various buildings and infrastructure markets is preferred.
 

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in related field

Posted Salary Range: Minimum

300,000.00

Posted Salary Range: Upper

390,000.00

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has a U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $300,000.00 to $390,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on November 11, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

card.title: Director, Information Technology Procurement Management (Director, Procurement Systems and Operations)
card.description:
**About NYC Health + Hospitals**
--------------------------------

 

NYC Health + Hospitals is the largest public health care system in the United States. We provide essential outpatient, inpatient and home-based services to more than one million New Yorkers every year across the city’s five boroughs. Our large health system consists of ambulatory centers, acute care centers, post-acute care/long-term care, rehabilitation programs, Home Care, and Correctional Health Services. Our diverse workforce is uniquely focused on empowering New Yorkers.

At NYC Health + Hospitals, our mission is to deliver high quality care health services, without exception. Every employee takes a person-centered approach that exemplifies the ICARE values (Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence) through empathic communication and partnerships between all persons.

**Work Shifts**
---------------

 

**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

 

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Strategic Planning

* Lead the indirect procurement function by developing and executing a comprehensive strategy to optimize spend across diverse non-clinical categories
* Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align procurement strategies with organizational goals and operational priorities
* Utilize data analytics and market intelligence to identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and supplier consolidation
* Develop operating procedures, internal policies, and training guides to support consistent procurement practices
* Partner with internal stakeholders to create scopes of work, request for proposals, and other solicitation documents

2. Operational Performance

* Oversee contracting, monitor contract compliance, and manage vendor relationships to ensure optimal pricing, service levels, and risk mitigation
* Drive cost-savings initiatives while maintaining compliance with healthcare regulations, organizational policies, and industry standards
* Manage capital procurement activities in coordination with internal and external partners throughout planning, budgeting, project management, and transactional phases
* Monitor supplier performance, manage risks, and resolve issues promptly to maintain uninterrupted service and supply
* Develop and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to savings, supplier performance, and process efficiency
* Prioritize procurement activities to meet end-user deadlines and expectations
* Develop and deliver executive briefings to senior leadership, providing insights on supply chain performance, risk mitigation, and strategic opportunities
* Perform related duties as required to support departmental and organizational objectives

3. Staff Development

* Train and lead a high-performing procurement team focused on operational excellence and professional growth
* Foster a collaborative and innovative team culture that encourages continuous learning and improvement
* Implement training programs to enhance team skills in strategic sourcing, contract management, and vendor relations
* Promote effective communication and engagement across all levels of the organization

4. Financial Management

* Lead spend reduction initiatives and ensure effective financial management of indirect procurement budgets
* Collaborate with finance and project teams to ensure accurate budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting
* Conduct procurement audits and risk assessments to maintain fiscal discipline and compliance
* Utilize financial data to track savings realization, cost avoidance, and return on investment

card.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines. 
 
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work? 

**Director - Integrated Services Access & Operations**
======================================================

**Entity:** Clinical Practices of the University of Pennsylvania 
**Department:** Psychiatry Administration 
**Location:** (based out of Penn Behavioral Health, 3535 Market Street, Philadelphia, PA) 
**Schedule:** 8-Hour Days

**Summary**
-----------

The Director of Integrated Services Access & Operations serves as a senior operational leader within the Department of Psychiatry, reporting jointly to the Chief Operating Officer and Vice Chair for Clinical Operations. This role provides strategic and operational leadership for integrated care programs and other clinical initiatives across the department and downtown entities.

Key responsibilities include improving patient access, optimizing operational performance, supporting financial sustainability, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing quality initiatives, and advancing data-driven decision-making to deliver high-quality, evidence-based patient care.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

#### **Strategic Operations & Program Leadership**

* Partner with departmental and health system leaders to evaluate, prioritize, and implement initiatives that improve patient access to innovative behavioral health services.
* Lead operational support for integrated care programs, including Penn Integrated Care (PIC), Mental Health Engagement Navigation & Delivery (MEND), and other departmental initiatives.
* Support expansion and optimization of neuromodulation services, including Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT), esketamine, and neurosurgical interventions.
* Oversee redesign and optimization of psychiatric admission and referral pathways.

#### **Penn Integrated Care (PIC)**

* Collaborate with clinical and operational leaders to develop, launch, and expand integrated behavioral health services in specialty and primary care settings.
* Partner with clinical practices to assess needs, implement workflows, establish operational processes, and support provider and staff onboarding.
* Coordinate training programs, reporting tools, patient registries, and clinical workflow enhancements.
* Monitor outcomes, operational performance, and compliance with collaborative care requirements.

#### **MEND & Care Navigation Programs**

* Support growth and expansion of MEND services across hospital settings.
* Review performance data and collaborate with hospital leadership on program improvements.
* Assist with implementation of technology solutions and operational dashboards to support care delivery.

#### **HUP Cedar Operations**

* Provide departmental operational support for HUP Cedar behavioral health services.
* Serve as liaison to site leadership to ensure alignment with departmental operations.
* Manage physician payroll, incentive payments, requisitions, and related administrative support.

#### **Quality, Compliance & Performance Improvement**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and regulatory requirements, including DOH, TJC, HIPAA, CMS, OSHA, and other governing bodies.
* Lead audit and survey readiness activities.
* Partner with clinical leadership to establish and achieve quality, access, service, and performance goals.
* Monitor and analyze operational and clinical performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.

#### **Staff Leadership**

* Manage selected outpatient clinical support staff.
* Directly supervise Medical Assistants and Clinical Service Associates supporting the 3535 Market Street ambulatory practices.
* Ensure competency assessments, training requirements, and scope-of-service standards are maintained.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

* Master's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
* 7+ years of relevant healthcare operations experience.
* Healthcare management experience preferred.
* RN or equivalent clinical licensure (e.g., LCSW, PT/OT, Speech-Language Pathology, Pharmacist) preferred.

We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives. 
 
Live Your Life's Work

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

card.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven **Senior Operations Manager** to lead and optimize operations within a fast-paced e-commerce logistics environment. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, ensuring customer satisfaction, maximizing productivity, and leading large teams across multiple shifts. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a strong background in distribution, fulfillment, logistics, and continuous improvement.

**About the Role**
------------------

**How you will contribute**

* Manage the daily activities of a logistics operation to maximize scheduling and delivery of commodities to the customer.
* Interface with customer to ensure smooth -coordination of scheduling and maximization of schedule adherence; provides input on local conditions, identifies needs and receives direction on real-time staffing increases or decreases.
* Enact contingency plans as needed; escalate and direct activities during system problems, disasters, etc.; identify potential problems, troubleshoot, escalate issues to local and senior management, and participate in post-mortem analysis of problems providing input for future process improvements.
* Review ongoing performance results to targets. Take corrective measures with authorization, escalate as needed
* Responsible for providing effective leadership to the Warehouse Managers and/or team, enforcing company standards, act as a role model.
* Other duties as assigned.
 

**Your Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or related field preferred.
* At least 5 Years of Progressive experience performing professional level operational and plant management duties; preferably in automotive or logistics industry.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or complaints. Ability to write documents using original or innovative techniques or style. Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations on controversial or complex topics to top management and customer.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* Proficient personal computer skills including electronic mail, record keeping, routine database activity, word processing, spreadsheet, graphics, etc.

**Compensation**

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package. The pay range for this role is $115,000 to 135,000, paid bi-weekly, with the potential for annual bonus payable in April every year. Company-offered benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with up to 4% Company match, paid time off, Company-paid Basic Life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability insurance, plus addtional voluntary and supplemental options and wellness programs.

**About DP World**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. card.description:

As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. **Job Summary**

Own the operating systems, governance, controls, enablement, and execution disciplines that allow Talent to deliver strategy consistently, safely, efficiently, and at scale. 
Translate Talent strategy and enterprise requirements into clear operating models, processes, controls, decision rights, knowledge, readiness, and adoption mechanisms while protecting regulatory, compliance, and business-continuity obligations.

**Job Description**

**Key Accountabilities:**

* **Design and govern the Talent operating model**, establishing clear processes, standards, decision rights, ownership, handoffs, and escalation mechanisms across Talent.
* **Own the Talent compliance operating framework**, translating Legal and Compliance requirements into operational controls, monitoring, documentation, evidence, and sustainable Talent practices.
* **Lead Talent audit readiness and coordination**, maintaining visibility to compliance obligations, control ownership, audit evidence, findings, remediation, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Provide governance and execution discipline for strategic programs**, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, risks, decisions, readiness, and accountability.
* **Lead organizational and operational readiness**, ensuring new processes, technologies, automation, and strategic programs can be successfully implemented and sustained.
* **Own change, adoption, and enablement disciplines**, translating organizational change into the knowledge, capabilities, communications, tools, and reinforcement required for successful execution.
* **Govern Talent knowledge and process architecture**, establishing trusted sources of truth, documentation standards, knowledge ownership, and scalable access to policies, processes, and guidance.
* **Drive process optimization and continuous improvement**, identifying friction, simplifying work, standardizing execution, and partnering with Technology & Automation partners to embed processes and controls into systems.
* **Own or coordinate Talent business continuity, operational risk, and records-management requirements** within the Talent operating environment.
* **Establish and govern the Talent responsibility model for AI-enabled work**, ensuring clear human accountability as automation scales through defined decision rights, policy and control logic, data and knowledge integrity, exception management, escalation paths, documentation, and ongoing oversight of AI-enabled processes and outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**

* Directing the implementation of operational policies to enhance organizational effectiveness and strategic execution
* Leading the design and execution of business strategies to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness
* Guiding cross-functional teams in the integration of analytics for robust strategic decision-making support
* Driving the optimization of business processes to improve overall performance and market positioning
* Championing the adoption of innovative operational practices to maintain a leading edge in business operations
* Steering the evaluation and refinement of operational policies to support dynamic business needs
* Cultivating a culture of continuous improvement to foster operational excellence and strategic growth
* Facilitating the alignment of financial and business analytics to inform and influence key strategic initiatives
* Managing the analysis and communication of management data to support operational decisions and highlight areas for improvement
* Aligning business processes within functional areas to the broader strategic objectives of the organization
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.

* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

Advanced Analytics, Business Process Improvements, Executive Leadership, Financial Management, Operational Excellence, Organizational Change Management, People Management

This job can be performed in Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Washington, and Denver Campus with a Pay Range of $132,421.96 - $248,291.18. Bachelor's Degree

**Locations: Charlotte**

**Uncap Your Potential at America's Largest Coca-Cola Bottler — Pour Your Passion into Purpose!**

We're more than beverages—we're building meaningful careers and vibrant communities. Join our team where your talent meets purpose, and every teammate directly shapes our success.

* **Career Growth:** Clear pathways to advance and develop your career
* **Competitive Benefits:** 401(k) match + health coverage + employee stock purchase plan
* **Purpose-Driven:** Create meaningful impact in the communities you serve
* **Professional Development:** Dedicated training + personalized mentorship

**Join us - your refreshing new chapter starts here!**

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director, Operations leads and coordinates the overall operational efforts of the Manufacturing center and provides leadership and direction for the Production, Quality Assurance, Maintenance and, or Building Maintenance teams. Promotes a team environment and fosters cooperative relationships with all internal and external customers and suppliers; while developing and directing a plan which ensures high production efficiencies, a safe work environment, and production of the highest quality product.

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Direct, manage, lead, and motivate the quality, maintenance, and production teams to deliver results by communicating company goals (including quality and customer satisfaction), safety practices, and deadlines; recruiting and retaining; engaging and developing teammates through effective performance management, coaching, and training; implementing continuous improvement methods while maintaining customer focus; and embodying company purpose and values to inspire servant leadership
* Oversee compliance with all Consolidated Management Systems, ISO standards, and quality agency requirements to ensure product quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and efficient operations
* Facilitate cross-functional actions to drive continuous improvement in production, quality, and safety
* Develop and manage expense, capital, and labor budgets to support CCCI’s budgeting, cost-related decision-making, and long-term financial planning
* Ensure the satisfaction of all internal and external customers, CCCI plants, and Corporate functions and develop strong partnerships with suppliers

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**
----------------------------------

* 5-7 years of previous experience in manufacturing Food and Beverage industry experience preferred
* Management Systems experience, ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, SQF
* Ability to lead, manage, and develop a team
* Computer skills – SAP, Microsoft Office Excel, PowerPoint
* Ability to manage constant change in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Ability to plan and execute complex projects
* Ability to stand for extended periods of time, walking manufacturing floor, climbing stairs, and lift up to 25lbs

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree (4 years)
* Knowledge acquired through 5 to up to 7 years of work experience
* Valid Driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business

**Work Environment**
--------------------

Noisy, wet, and extreme temperature environment

Equal Opportunity Employer - All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
