card.title: VP Operations
card.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions. 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence. 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance. 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include, but not limited to the following.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support.
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact.
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance.
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements.
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability.
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations.
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements.
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives.
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies.
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: **Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring.**

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions.
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation.
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant.
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365.
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste.
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills.
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave
* Life Insurance, Identity Protection, and more!

Relocation assistance is not available. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Daubert Chemical Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Disability/Veteran.

card.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**The Opportunity**

The Director of Academic Innovation Strategy & Operations advances the Division of Academic Innovation’s strategic and operational priorities by leading complex projects, driving strategic planning and execution, overseeing professional development and events, and cultivating internal and external partnerships. This position translates divisional strategy into measurable outcomes that support academic innovation.

The successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership, guide cross-functional initiatives, develop team capabilities, and partner with executive leadership to advance divisional goals. This role also oversees project management, operational improvements, performance evaluation, and the development and implementation of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools that support divisional operations.

**About us**

For over 100 years, Embry-Riddle has been the world's leading aviation and aerospace university, educating more than 30,000 students across residential campuses in Daytona Beach, Florida, and Prescott, Arizona, as well as through a global network of Worldwide locations and online programs. With more than 165,000 alumni around the world, our impact reaches every corner of the aerospace, aviation, defense and technology industries.

Today, our faculty, researchers and professional staff are advancing innovation across aviation, space, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, autonomous systems and next-generation engineering. Working alongside industry leaders, government agencies and innovators, they are solving real-world challenges and shaping the technologies that will define tomorrow.

Whether you are an educator, researcher, administrator, technologist or industry professional, your work at Embry-Riddle will contribute to something bigger than a job. Join a community driven by discovery, purpose and excellence—and help shape the future of aerospace.

* ***Generous Time Off:*** *Enjoy up to 18 days of paid leave in your first year, including 3 days granted upon hire and 15 days accrued throughout the year. You'll also receive 9+ paid holidays, including the day after Thanksgiving and the week between Christmas Eve and New Year's Day.*
* ***Tuition Coverage:*** *Get 100% tuition coverage for yourself for one undergraduate and one graduate degree, and discounted rates for your spouse and dependent children up to age 26.*
* ***Retirement Contributions:*** *ERAU contributes 6% of your base salary to your retirement plan and offers a 4% matching contribution – with no vesting period.*
* ***Personal Leave:*** *Relax with 15 days of personal leave for non-exempt employees or 18 days for exempt full-time employees in your first year.*

**Qualifications**
==================

* Master's degree in a relevant field or 2–3 years of relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience in strategic planning and developing operational strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects and initiatives involving diverse stakeholders.
* Experience with project management methodologies and tools; familiarity with Wrike preferred.
* Strong organizational, leadership, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to understand stakeholder needs, communicate solutions effectively, and present confidently to audiences at all organizational levels.
* Demonstrated experience in team leadership, mentorship, and stakeholder engagement.
* Familiarity with educational technologies such as Canvas LMS; AI-enabled tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot; innovation and problem-solving methodologies such as Design Thinking; and strategic planning software such as Anthology.
* Ability to adapt to changing technologies, timelines, and departmental needs.
* Experience with event planning preferred.

To submit your application for this opportunity, please visit the Embry-Riddle Career Site and search for requisition number **R312466**. Please attach all relevant materials to your application when you apply online. Complete submissions include:

* Cover letter
* Resume
* Contact information for at least three professional references (please note that references may be contacted as part of the interview/screening process)

**Current Embry-Riddle employees:** Please apply directly through the ERAU Employee Hub Central application within Workday.

Embry-Riddle is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We strive to ensure that all faculty, staff, and students are treated fairly and provided equal opportunities for employment, advancement, compensation, training, and other benefits of employment. Embry-Riddle makes employment decisions — including hiring, promotions, compensation, and other terms of employment — based on individual merit, qualifications, and abilities. Embry-Riddle is strongly opposed to discrimination and harassment, and such behavior is prohibited by university policy. Embry-Riddle does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, veteran status, predisposing genetic characteristics, age, religion, or pregnancy status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law, in its employment, educational programs, admissions policies, financial aid, or other school-administered programs or activities. For further information, please visit our website.

Embry-Riddle does not accept unsolicited assistance from staffing or recruitment agencies. Agencies interested in partnering with the University should contact eraujobs@erau.edu and should not contact hiring managers or other University employees directly.

To preserve the integrity and authenticity of our hiring process, candidates are expected to participate without AI-assisted coaching, real-time response generation, or recording during interviews or assessments. Embry-Riddle does not use AI to automatically screen, rank, or select candidates.

card.title: Director, Loyalty Strategy & Operations
card.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

 

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the role**
----------------------------

 

The Director of Loyalty Strategy & Operations will own Brand Expedia's loyalty strategy and operational delivery globally, while also leading the cross-brand element of loyalty across Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo.

 

Reporting directly to the VP of Customer Growth & Loyalty for Brand Expedia, this role is best suited to a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of loyalty program best practices, program economics, and operational scaling.

 

You will bring a data-driven approach and an analytical mindset to dive into insights, listen to travelers, and uncover growth opportunities that ladder up to our broader organizational goals.

 

Close collaboration with Brand Expedia leadership and cross-brand partners is essential to align loyalty strategy with brand-specific goals and key performance indicators. This role regularly interfaces with executive (SVP+ and C-level) leadership as well as cross-functional partners across all levels, requiring authentic relationship-building and strong stakeholder alignment.

 

Additionally, this role proactively identifies opportunities to improve traveler journeys, elevate engagement, and strengthen brand loyalty through continuous enhancements to current offerings, prioritizing simplicity, operational rigor, and traveler comprehension.

 

Finally, this role is external-facing and engages with key strategic partners and third-party entities, fostering high-impact relationships to elevate the Brand Expedia traveler experience.

 

**In this role, you will:**

 

**Strategic Vision & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Own the vision and develop strategies to grow and strengthen customer relationships, repeat bookings, and long-term stickiness through Brand Expedia loyalty and customer growth initiatives.
* Drive a comprehensive loyalty and customer growth agenda, aligning program value propositions with short-term incentives, lifecycle touchpoints, and personalized member experiences.
* Manage and strengthen cross-functional relationships across Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo to ensure tight alignment between loyalty operations and brand strategy.
* Act as an energetic advocate for loyalty at every level, connecting program strategy back to the company's broader business objectives and ensuring loyalty has a clear voice across the organization.
* Flex effortlessly between high-level strategic vision and detailed operational execution, knowing when to dive into mechanics and when to empower your team.
* Utilize market research, customer insights, competitor intelligence, and behavioral data analytics to identify high-potential customer segments and personalize member engagement.
* Design, implement, and optimize loyalty offerings and operational workflows to ensure they deliver tangible customer value and achieve business targets.
* Serve as the dedicated voice of the traveler, partnering closely with brand marketing, product development, and member experience teams.
* Balance agile, short-term experimentation (such as rapid test-and-learn initiatives) with scalable, long-term programmatic frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with Loyalty Performance, Finance, and Analytics teams on program economics, business casing, and measurement, while partnering with Product, Technology, and Experience Design (XD) to deliver seamless end-to-end traveler journeys.
Coordinate with CRM, Integrated Marketing, Research & Insights, and commercial teams to drive cohesive execution across channels. 

 

**Team Leadership & Operational Stewardship**

* Lead, inspire, and grow a high-performing organization of 6 team members, including direct management of 3 Senior Managers, cultivating an inclusive, innovative environment with a "Go Get What's Next" mindset.
* Guide team operations, resource allocation, and project roadmaps to ensure seamless delivery across all strategic loyalty streams.
* Empower team members to move quickly, resolve roadblocks independently, and drive measurable outcomes with clarity.
* Unlock each team member's full potential, supporting individualized development paths and career progression.
* Build trust, positive momentum, and mutual accountability across the team and with executive stakeholders.
Balance workloads effectively so all team members are fully engaged and given meaningful opportunities to stretch their leadership capabilities. 

 

**Experience & Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in loyalty strategy, customer lifecycle marketing, or commercial growth, with a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of demonstrated people leadership experience, with proven success managing people leaders (e.g. Senior Managers) and developing high-performing teams.
* Proven track record leading large-scale, global loyalty programs and complex operational workstreams that deliver exceptional business outcomes.
* Deep domain expertise in modern loyalty strategies, customer retention, motivational mechanics, and incentive design.
* Strong business acumen and analytical capability to interpret complex data, model program economics, and make decisive, value-generating decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships across diverse groups, including Product, Technology, Analytics, Finance, Supply, Brand Marketing, and Customer Operations.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with a proven ability to influence, socialize recommendations, and drive alignment at all leadership levels.
* Passion for designing delightful customer experiences and driving customer retention through customer-centric, data-grounded approaches.
* Thrives in a dynamic, collaborative environment, managing multiple priorities with sound judgment, adaptability, and high attention to detail.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and modern collaboration tools.
* Experience with Tableau or similar business intelligence and analytics platforms.
Proactive curiosity and ability to leverage modern AI tools to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and elevate team efficiency. 

 
The total cash range for this position in New York is $224,000.00 to $313,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $358,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.
The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. 
 

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

 

**Benefits and perks**

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life .

 

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

 

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

 

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

 

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

card.title: Director, Contract Operations
card.description:
We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**About First Advantage**

First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.

Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.

**What You'll Do**

**Director, Global Contract Operations** is responsible for establishing the operational strategy, governance framework, technology roadmap, and performance standards for the Company's global contracting function.

This role serves as the senior operational leader within Legal responsible for contract intake governance, workflow administration, process transformation, contract lifecycle management (CLM) optimization, contracting technology enablement and operational support services.

The position partners closely with Legal leadership, Sales, Procurement, Compliance, IT, Finance, and regional business leaders to develop scalable contracting capabilities that support business growth, operational efficiency, risk mitigation, and governance objectives.

The Director serves as the primary operational liaison between Legal leadership and business stakeholders, translating approved legal policies, playbooks, and contracting standards into sustainable processes, systems, controls, and service delivery models.

While this role does not make legal risk determinations or provide legal advice, it is accountable for enterprise-wide contracting operational effectiveness, contracting technology strategy, workflow governance, and continuous improvement initiatives supporting the Legal function.

**This role is 100% work from home role within the United States.**

**Strategic Leadership & Operating Model Ownership**

* Define and execute the global contract operations strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
* Establish enterprise-wide standards for contract intake, prioritization, assignment, workflow execution, escalation and service delivery.
* Lead alignment of contracting operations across regions, business units, functions and contract types.
* Identify operational risks, scalability challenges, and process inefficiencies and develop long-term solutions.
* Serve as executive owner of contracting operational processes, procedures, governance standards, and service delivery models
* Advise senior leadership on operational strategy, resource planning, and transformation opportunities.

**Process Transformation & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead enterprise-wide process improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, standardization, automation, and scalability.
* Own and continuously improve the global intake, triage, assignment, and workflow management framework.
* Establish and maintain global SOPs, process maps, RACI models, and operational documentation standards.
* Sponsor cross-functional initiatives that improve contracting effectiveness and stakeholder experience.
* Drive implementation of best practices, automation opportunities, and operational controls across the contract lifecycle.
* Lead remediation efforts for systemic operational bottlenecks and recurring process issues.

At Curaleaf, we're redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our *Rooted in Good* initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

 

**Title:** Director of Operations 
**Location:** Webster, MA 
**Job Type:** Full Time | Exempt

**Who You Are:**

You're a strategic, hands-on operations leader who knows how to run complex, multi-site supply-side operations from end to end. You bring structure, accountability, and calm to fast-moving environments, with a deep understanding of what it takes to make and deliver at scale—safely, compliantly, and efficiently.

You have a proven ability to lead and coach field operations teams across cultivation, processing, manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and facilities, while balancing day-to-day execution with long-term operational strategy. You're comfortable owning results and making decisions that directly impact revenue, cost, quality, and team performance.

You partner naturally across the business, working closely with Retail, Wholesale, Marketing, Finance, People & Culture, and Compliance to align priorities and execute against shared goals. You're detail-driven but not rigid, data-informed but people-first, and you continuously look for smarter, more efficient ways to operate.

Above all, you set the standard. You lead with safety, compliance, and quality at the forefront, drive continuous improvement, and build high-performing teams that deliver results while maintaining strong engagement and morale.

**What You'll Do:**

As a Director of Operations, you will lead and oversee all supply-side operations across cultivation, manufacturing, logistics, and facilities, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient execution of the end-to-end make and deliver process while driving performance, quality, and profitability.

* Lead all day-to-day cultivation, manufacturing, and supply-side operations, planning and monitoring execution to ensure uninterrupted, efficient production
* Lead, develop, and coach site operations leadership teams, setting clear priorities, cascading goals, and driving accountability across all Make and Deliver functions
* Own metrics-based OKRs and drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, including Lean Six Sigma initiatives
* Maintain a strong field presence to support leaders and teams while fostering safe, compliant, and brand-appropriate manufacturing environments
* Oversee production planning, scheduling, logistics, and inventory flow from raw materials through finished goods
* Partner with Commercial, Retail, and Wholesale teams to translate demand, growth, and trends into accurate manufacturing forecasts and execution plans
* Collaborate with regional and national shared services to commercialize new products in the local market
* Ensure controlled substance inventory accuracy, variance resolution, SOX compliance, and adherence to all local, state, and national SOPs
* Maintain quality, safety, and compliance standards to reduce NOEs and non-conformances and ensure cost-effective operations in a GAP and cGMP environment
* Lead training, development, and recurring compliance initiatives across field operations
* Manage vendor and contractor relationships, bills of materials, standard costing, and ERP-related operational processes
* Lead capital improvement projects and oversee commissioning and maintenance of capital equipment
* Own site P&L, OPEX, labor standards, and org structures to control costs, reduce COGS, and improve operating margins

**What You'll Bring:**

* 10+ years of experience in manufacturing and logistics, with leadership experience in FDA-regulated, SQF, or cGMP production environments
* Experience supervising 25+ associates, with a proven ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing teams
* A hands-on, visible leadership style that earns credibility quickly and inspires trust across all levels of the organization
* A demonstrated track record of driving operational efficiencies, improving performance, and leading teams through change
* Strong people leadership, organizational, and collaboration skills, with the ability to build consensus through open dialogue
* The ability to work proactively and independently, bringing innovation, urgency, and ownership to both strategic and tactical goals
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, both internally and externally
* High School diploma required

**Even Better If:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Experience in the cannabis industry
* Working knowledge of Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma principles, with practical application experience
* Start-up or high-growth environment experience

**What We Offer:**

* Career Growth Opportunities
* Competitive Pay and Benefits
* Generous PTO and Parental Leave
* 401(K) Retirement Plan
* Life/ Disability Insurance
* Community Involvement
* Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

*Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.*

Twitter: @Curaleaf\_Inc

card.description:
At IEM, we're not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we're shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what's possible. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting out, you'll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world's most dynamic markets.

IEM is seeking a Director of Operations to lead Medium Voltage Switchgear, Integrated Products, and Small Panels manufacturing in Jacksonville, Florida. This role owns safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, capacity, and team development across the assigned product lines.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operations leader with experience scaling complex, high-mix manufacturing environments, building strong leaders, implementing Lean operating systems, and ensuring disciplined daily execution.

**Please note: This position requires 100% in-office presence in our** **Jacksonville****offices and does not offer remote work.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Set and execute the operating strategy for Medium Voltage Switchgear, Integrated Products, and Small Panels.
* Align production, capacity, labor, scheduling, materials flow, maintenance, and support priorities with business objectives and customer commitments.
* Translate backlog and forecasted demand into practical labor, equipment, facility, material, and production capacity plans.
* Lead critical customer deliverables, production recovery plans, new-product introductions, and major internal initiatives.
* Provide timely operational updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans to the Vice President of Operations and Executive Leadership Team.
* Champion a culture where safety is a core operating value and leadership responsibility.
* Improve safety performance through hazard reduction, employee engagement, and proactive risk mitigation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, internal, and customer requirements, including OSHA, ISO, UL, and product-specific quality standards.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for nonconformances, defects, and recurring operational issues.
* Maintain readiness for customer audits, regulatory reviews, certifications, and changing compliance requirements.
* Build a continuous-improvement culture grounded in operational discipline, accountability, and fact-based problem-solving.
* Champion Lean practices such as daily management, visual management, standard work, takt alignment, flow, pull systems, workplace organization, and structured problem-solving.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, delivery, cost, labor productivity, yield, schedule attainment, throughput, work-in-process, and asset utilization.
* Use real-time operating data and visual management to identify risks, prioritize resources, and accelerate decisions.
* Reduce manufacturing costs through effective use of labor, equipment, facilities, materials, and capital.
* Partner with Finance on operating plans, budgets, variances, and cost-improvement commitments.
* Lead and develop Value Stream Managers, Operations Managers, and senior manufacturing leaders across the assigned product lines.
* Build a high-performing organization through selection, onboarding, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.
* Strengthen frontline leadership through clear expectations, management routines, decision rights, and accountability.
* Foster teamwork, engagement, and ownership through visible leadership and consistent involvement.
* Lead organizational and cultural changes needed to support IEM's growth and increasing operational maturity.
* Partner with EHS, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Process Improvement, Supply Chain, Procurement, Human Resources, Finance, and other support teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional priorities to remove production barriers, improve manufacturability, resolve quality issues, and maintain production flow.
* Work with Engineering and Quality on new-product introductions, design changes, process qualification, corrective actions, and manufacturing readiness.
* Align production requirements with material availability, supplier performance, inventory objectives, and customer demand.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field required; master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced education preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing or operations experience, including 5+ years in senior leadership roles.
* Experience leading large-scale, high-mix, multi-stage, engineered-to-order, configure-to-order, or vertically integrated manufacturing operations.
* Background in medium-voltage switchgear, electrical distribution equipment, integrated power systems, industrial controls, panel manufacturing, or a comparable technical manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Proven success improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, throughput, cost, and employee engagement.
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, daily management systems, visual management, standard work, capacity planning, production flow, and plant layout optimization.
* Experience scaling operations, leading plant-wide initiatives, implementing automation, and introducing digital performance-management tools.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, cost management, capital planning, and operational performance analysis.
* Ability to lead through complexity, set priorities, manage change, communicate effectively, and hold teams accountable for measurable results.
* Demonstrated career progression and potential to assume broader leadership responsibilities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization.

Compensation actually offered for this role will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

**Why Join IEM**

At IEM, you'll join a team that powers some of the world's most ambitious projects. We're engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you're driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

**Recruiting Scams**

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

**Non-Discrimination Statement**

IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law.
